messages:
Maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Chen, Tara, and the infra crew for the 2am demo rescue. Bought 6 ice cream vouchers for the team as a tiny thank you. To claim one, drop a pet photo in this thread? :icecream: :dog:
Chen: Oh wow, Maya, that's so kind but totally not necessary. Grateful though! Pixel will be thrilled. :heart:
Tara: Legendary team move. Saved the demo and my weekend :raised_hands: Claiming one!
Liam: If there's pistachio I will definitely accept responsibility for consumption :sunglasses: Claiming one too.
Anya: Pet photo incoming — Sir Meowsalot is ready for his modeling debut. :cat:
Maya: I'll DM codes after you post photos. No pressure if you don't want to participate — just a fun way to say thanks.
Chen: Here you go — Pixel unplugged himself mid-nap and fell into a very dramatic loaf. [img]pixie_pixel_sleep.jpg[/img] :camera_with_flash:
Liam: Pixel loaf!!! :heart_eyes: (reacts :heart:)
Tara: Aww that's adorable. Claimed — thanks Maya. Also quick shoutout to Liam for the rollback tip earlier, saved us time :clap:
Anya: Sir Meowsalot demands tuna and accepts the voucher on my behalf. Claiming! :cat2:
Maya: Claimed so far: Tara, Anya, Chen, Liam. 2 left — @Niko, @Sam?
Niko: I'm gonna pass, pls give to interns if they want! :raised_hands:
Sam: Same, interns first. But huge thanks everyone for the hustle. :sparkles:
Maya: Cool — I'll hold the last 2 for interns and send the codes. Thanks again team, tiny sweets but big appreciation. :icecream: 
Maya: Also feel free to drop more pet pics anytime, morale booster for the week. :)
